winuae-amiga-emulator.title: WinUAE
winuae-amiga-emulator.notes: Actively maintained Windows Amiga emulator and a key compatibility/debugging tool for Amiga reverse engineering and retro development. Tracked as adjacent tooling rather than as a source-reconstruction target.

wonder-boy-monsterland-st.title: Wonder Boy in Monsterland
wonder-boy-monsterland-st.notes: 330 functions verified; reconstructed game boots a real STE from its own floppy.

zool-2-aga-hitchhikr.title: Zool 2 AGA — Amiga disassembly
zool-2-aga-hitchhikr.notes: Complete Zool 2 AGA disassembly, described as clean enough to assemble and alter. Its workflow extracts the original disks, combines parallel IRA/disassembly strategies, rebuilds sections with vasm and tests the result with the original floppy data.

zynaps-atari-st.title: Zynaps
zynaps-atari-st.notes: Verified C reconstruction plus m68k hot-path twins; STE-confirmed playable with frame-level comparisons to the original.
